children: A proposal posted on ZetaHub would convert ZETA into a Solana native SPL token on a 1:1 basis while keeping the existing ticker. According to ChainCatcher, no migration will take place until ZETA holders complete a vote.

The proposal also plans to introduce the privacy-focused multimodal AI application Anuma, which reportedly has 300,000 users and supports unified memory across models. It has also launched a beta feature for real-life social discovery. Voting is set to begin on September 17 and will last 72 hours.

title: ZetaHub Proposal Would Convert ZETA Into Solana SPL Token
